candidates.tagline: $6,880 for a ZTE phone in calfskin that can't tell 2am from 9pm
candidates.story: Vertu's $6,880 Alphafold — reviewed by TechCrunch on July 17, 2026 — is fundamentally a $1,100 ZTE foldable phone wrapped in calfskin leather and titanium; the flagship AI executive assistant set a reminder for 9:08pm when asked at 2:32am, forgot documents it had analyzed days earlier, and abandoned a business travel booking mid-task.
candidates.why_funny: An AI assistant sold at a 6x luxury markup as a replacement for your executive PA cannot tell the difference between 2am and 9pm.
candidates.alt: Vertu Alphafold foldable phone standing open on a wooden table in front of floral wallpaper, showing the home screen with the tagline 'LIFE BEAUTIFULLY ARRANGED' and the VERTU Hermes AI app icon

candidates.tagline: AWS charges a guy $7 trillion. His normal bill: five cents.
candidates.story: Amazon Web Services' billing system confused gigabytes with bytes on July 17, 2026 — a 1-billion-fold unit conversion error — sending customers estimated bills as high as $7.1 trillion for accounts that normally owe pennies; AWS acknowledged the bug on social media with: 'Typo alert: Slight miscalculation on our end (very slight)'
candidates.why_funny: The company trusted with running roughly a third of the internet's infrastructure made a CS101 bytes-vs-gigabytes mistake and invoiced one customer for more than twice Amazon's entire market cap.
candidates.alt: Chromatic-aberration glitch effect on the AWS logo — the lowercase 'aws' lettering appears with yellow and blue colour-channel offsets against a dark grey background, with the familiar Amazon orange arrow-smile beneath
